input.overview: Split Second combines a lit-spinner route with a captive-ball release ladder. Spell S-P-L-I-T S-E-C-O-N-D to raise the spinner, use either center three-bank for Bonus X up to 15x, and release captive balls with drop-bank completions or the lit 50,000 Release All target.
input.simpleOverview: Spell SPLIT SECOND to raise the spinner, and complete either center three-bank to raise Bonus X. Drop banks release one captive ball; when Release All is lit, hit the 50,000 target to release the group.
input.summary: Build the spinner through SPLIT SECOND, raise Bonus X with the center banks, and use controlled captive-ball releases rather than forcing dangerous rebound shots.

quickInfo.name: Raise Spinner
quickInfo.summary: Complete SPLIT SECOND; the slings move the lit letter.

quickInfo.name: Raise Bonus X
quickInfo.summary: Complete either center three-bank, up to 15x.

quickInfo.name: Release All
quickInfo.summary: Complete SPLIT SECOND, then hit the lit 50,000 target.

steps.text: Use sling hits to move the lit letter, then score the matching target or lane until SPLIT SECOND is complete.
Shoot the now-lit spinner for its raised per-spin value.
Complete either center three-bank to raise Bonus X toward 15x.
Complete a captive-ball drop bank to release one ball, or hit the lit 50,000 Release All target after completing SPLIT SECOND.

alternatives.title: Left-orbit captive-ball route
alternatives.when: Use this when the left orbit and captive-ball feed are safer than direct center-bank rebounds.

steps.text: Send the ball around the left orbit toward the captive-ball area.
Take incidental captive and letter progress.
Return to the spinner when its value is built.
Complete SPLIT SECOND to build the spinner and light Release All.
Complete center three-banks until Bonus X reaches 15x.
Use the spinner and a controlled captive-ball release for the scoring finish.

machineSetup: Test letter movement from both slings, the spinner value lamps, both center three-banks, captive-ball drop banks, release mechanisms, and 50,000 target.
Confirm Extra Ball, Bonus Ball, and Special conversion before competitive play.
